messages:
Mira (PM): quick thread we need to finalize the launch-gate matrix for the 'tenant hot cache' initiative. i sketched three gates (alpha, beta, ga) and a small hotfix policy. can each team drop the single must-have item to clear beta?
Jon (Eng): eng must-have = per-tenant toggle + throttling at the API layer. without tenant-level opt-out we can't protect noisy customers. also need a deterministic model pin for canaries.
Priya (Runtime): runtime must-have = transparent cache-warm migration or a read-through fallback. if we can't warm the prefixes quickly, latency regressions will break our p95 SLA. also request a 24h rollback window to rehydrate caches if hotfix required.
Diego (Infra): infra must-have = scheduled prewarm reservations and a burst SLO for the beta cohort. we need confirmed GPU reservations and a small host quota increase. plus a plan for cross-region failover for private tenants.
Nadia (Security): security must-have = exportable audit trail for cache access and a short threat-model addendum for tenant-prefetch behavior. also we need an encrypted-in-transit proof for any backfill mechanisms.
Kai (SRE): sre must-have = automated circuit breaker that flips on error-rate or sustained p95 above threshold; plus a playbook for manual hotfix that can disable cache at edge. we also want synthetic monitors that simulate tenant burst profiles.
Mira (PM): thanks. two follow-ups: 1) what's your beta acceptance test (one-liner)? 2) owner confirmation.
Jon (Eng): acceptance test = exercise 10 tenants in parallel with mixed prompt shapes for 60m, verify per-tenant p95 < 400ms and error rate < 0.5%. owner = Jon (Eng) ok.
Priya (Runtime): acceptance test = end-to-end run with seeded KV backfill for 48h window; p95 degradation <= 1.15x baseline. owner = Priya (Runtime) ok.
Diego (Infra): acceptance test = 30m prewarm simulation at 2x expected beta QPS with failover simulation. owner = Diego (Infra) ok (will post reservation ETA).
Nadia (Security): acceptance test = run export + tamper-check on sample tenant audit, and review threat-model doc. owner = Nadia (Security) ok.
Kai (SRE): acceptance test = hit canary ramp plan and trigger circuit-breaker tests; run synthetic tenant burst; owner = Kai (SRE) ok.
Mira (PM): good. i'm going to add a "hotfix constraints" column on the matrix: what minimal code path must exist to patch without deploy? please add one-line entries.
Jon (Eng): hotfix constraint = admin feature-flag to disable prefetch per-tenant and a fast config toggle for global throttle.
Priya (Runtime): hotfix constraint = read-through fallback that can be toggled without cache invalidation; graceful degrade to on-demand token path.
Diego (Infra): hotfix constraint = ability to instantaneously scale prewarm pool down and migrate traffic to fallback region within 5m.
Nadia (Security): hotfix constraint = emergency revocation of any prefetch credentials and audit snapshot.
Kai (SRE): hotfix constraint = runbook with prebuilt rollback script and one-click toggles in ops-console.
Mira (PM): i've got everything i need for the matrix. one last ask please estimate risk level (low/med/high) for beta based on current blockers. i'll compile into the roadmap doc.
Jon (Eng): risk = med (need toggle + pin, but doable in 2 sprints).
Priya (Runtime): risk = med-high (migration/backfill timing uncertain; need test window).
Diego (Infra): risk = med (capacity reservations pending finance sign-off).
Nadia (Security): risk = low-med (docs mostly ready; residency checks pending for private tenants).
Kai (SRE): risk = med (circuit-breaker automation halfway done).
ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder create ticket T-1124 in launches board and link the matrix doc when available :pushpin:
Mira (PM): thanks team i'll post the matrix and proposed canary schedule by EOD PT. if you want edits, comment on the doc or ping me. :calendar:
